name: self_hosted_runner_spawn_local
description: Spawn a self-hosted runner as a detached background process on THIS machine using this binary's `self-hosted-runner` subcommand. Always passes `--base-dir` (the runner's default of /workspace is unwritable on operator laptops) and uses space-separated flags only. Returns {pid, log_path, health_port, command} — `command` is the equivalent shell line for the operator's cheat sheet. This is for the zero→aha proof; production deployment (k8s / docker-compose) is taught, not tooled.

secret_file_path.description: Path to the environment secret the operator saved from the Admin UI.

base_dir.description: Always passed to the runner (its built-in default of /workspace is unwritable on laptops). Default: ./runner-setup/workspace
